summary: Frontend-only visual/branding regression tests for BRUNO rebranding to corporate colors (#ffffff, #f9f1ea cream, #ff6a00 orange, #474747 gray). All specified checks passed: login mascot, brand-header-mark on Marketplace/MyProfile/Notifications/Settings, no marketplace mobile overflow, reels-surface applied (not bg-black) with correct light cream / dark gray background, dark body ~rgb(51,51,51) (gray, not pure black) on /notifications and /chat, avatar-fallback with span.bruno-mark, desktop chat 'Tus Mensajes' empty panel with bear, bottom nav present, no 404s for the listed brand assets, no webpack compile overlay.
action_items: (Minor, pre-existing) Console shows React hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>/<select>'. Not part of this iteration but should be cleaned up in a follow-up.

(Minor, unrelated to this iteration) Some 3rd-party 420 responses (Cloudinary rate-limit) and unrelated 404s on non-brand resources observed. Brand assets (/brand/*, /bruno-logo.png, /favicon-256.png, /bruno-mascot.png) returned no 404s.
critical_code_review_comments: BrunoAvatar fallback correctly renders span.bruno-mark; verified via [data-testid=avatar-fallback] on chat list.
Reels container uses class 'reels-surface' and adapts via CSS variables to light/dark (light: rgb(249,242,235) ~ cream, dark: rgb(41,41,41) corporate gray).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebranding iteration verified. Theme is toggled by 'light'/'dark' class on <html>. Reels page container has data-testid=reels-page and class reels-surface. Avatars fallback selector: [data-testid=avatar-fallback] containing span.bruno-mark. Brand header mark: [data-testid=brand-header-mark]. All required visual regressions passed on mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080.
